content: <thought>We applied the Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons template (reaction_id 1914389) to the three candidate product SMILES. The template succeeded for the first SMILES, yielding a pair of precursors, and for the second SMILES (to be processed next). It did not match the third SMILES, so no precursors are generated for it. After applying the template to the second SMILES, we will collect all successful precursor sets and present them as a list of lists.</thought>
